name: google-workspace-mcp-bounded-google-api-e0fd
instr:
Add bounded, opt-in reuse of authenticated Google Workspace clients so repeated calls avoid needless construction without crossing authorization identities. Reuse must have explicit lease ownership, deterministic capacity behavior, safe invalidation, and sanitized runtime visibility. Existing authentication selection and Workspace tool behavior must remain compatible.

`ServiceCacheKey.create` derives canonical, secret-free identities from service, version, principal, authentication mode, credential generation, and effective scope set. Callable `ServiceLease.service()` returns the client, as does context entry, until idempotent `release`, after which access raises `ServiceLeaseReleased`. `GoogleServicePool` coalesces equal concurrent acquisitions, shares build failures, protects active leases, and deterministically evicts the eligible least-recently-released entry; `invalidate` affects only its identity and returns whether an entry was invalidated, and `snapshot` exposes aggregate state. Reuse is disabled by default, bounded when enabled, rejects invalid limits with `ValueError`, and leaves existing OAuth environment precedence unchanged. Effective scopes preserve declared-scope enforcement and read-only substitution while isolating OAuth 2.1, legacy OAuth, trusted gateway, service-account, and delegated-subject identities. `require_google_service` and `require_multiple_services` from `auth.service_decorator` release every acquired lease on success, API failure, cancellation,
